sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Spirited Skully is a game about timing and reflexes. The gameplay is simple - tap the screen to make the skull flap and stay afloat - but the challenge lies in executing it perfectly. As you navigate through the levels, you'll encounter all sorts of obstacles, from pipes and tunnels to spiky balls and other hazards. The key to success lies in mastering the timing of your flaps, using the momentum to your advantage to avoid danger and reach the next level.

One of the most unique aspects of Spirited Skully is its use of momentum to control the skull's movement. By timing your flaps correctly, you can use the skull's speed to your advantage, using it to glide over obstacles or propel it upwards to avoid danger. This adds a whole new layer of depth to the game, making it feel more like a challenge of strategy and skill rather than just pure luck.

But don't be fooled - the game still has its fair share of luck involved. The obstacles are unpredictable and can appear at any moment, requiring you to think on your feet and react quickly to avoid disaster. This makes for a thrilling gameplay experience that's both challenging and rewarding.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter new obstacles and challenges that will test your skills to the limit. From narrow tunnels to treacherous spikes, each level presents a new and unique challenge that requires you to adapt and improvise. This is what makes Spirited Skully so addictive - the game is always changing, always throwing new obstacles and challenges at you to keep you on your toes.
